page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.3xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance featuring 12 dedicated virtual CPUs and 48 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio. Driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock of 2.9 GHz across 6 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled, the instance includes 48 MB of Level 3 cache along with 1 MB of Level 2 cache per core. Compute instruction extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, alongside hardware-accelerated cryptographic primitives including AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Hardware resource allocations do not include dedicated accelerators, reporting zero GPUs, and local disk storage is not bundled, necessitating network-attached storage volumes for persistent data. Baseline networking throughput is provisioned at 4 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor architecture, without complimentary public IPv4 addresses included by default.

Benchmark measurements position the instance squarely in the median bracket across compute, memory, and application-level workloads. It registers a single-core Geekbench score of 1570.0 and a multi-core score of 7817.0, matched by a PassMark CPU composite score of 16425.3. In compression workflows, single-threaded gzip reaches 28.04 GB/sec while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 63.45 GB/sec. Uncached large-block memory operations achieve 83.06 GB/sec for reads and 53.58 GB/sec for writes. Redis throughput measures 11.94 million SET operations per second, while static web serving delivers 17.05 GB/sec.

The primary performance tradeoff centers on machine learning inference. While small 135M parameter models process prompts at 1071.79 tokens per second, prompt processing for medium 7B parameter models drops into the lower 25th percentile at 24.26 tokens per second due to the lack of dedicated acceleration hardware. Accordingly, the ecs.g7se.3xlarge serves effectively for mid-tier enterprise software deployments, Redis caching, software compilation, CI/CD pipelines, and general web application servers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.3xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance running on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.9 GHz. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs (6 physical cores with 2 threads per core), 48 GB of memory, and 48 MB of L3 cache, maintaining a balanced 1:4 CPU-to-RAM ratio. Instruction support includes AVX-512 and crypto-acceleration sets such as AES and SHA-NI. The instance includes no bundled local storage and no GPUs, relying on remote volumes and 4 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. Benchmarks reflect consistent mid-tier performance, producing a Geekbench multi-core score of 7817.0 and 11.94 million Redis SET operations per second. However, medium-scale LLM processing remains constrained without hardware acceleration. The instance is suited for enterprise application servers, Redis data caching, build pipelines, and general backend workloads.
